meta.description: From 0 at the base to 1 at the tip: where a branch or instance sits on its parent path, and along the path for thickness and color. Across goes from 0 on the middle of a geometry to 1 at its edge, set_color, leaf_surface and deform read it at every vertex. Vein goes from 0 on a vein of a leaf to 1 at the edge of its groove, leaf_surface reads it at every vertex. Everywhere else across and vein are 0.

direction.description: Along goes from the base to the tip, across from the middle of a geometry to its edge, like from the midrib of a leaf to its margin, vein from a vein of leaf_surface to the edge of its groove.
